facts.summary: Voluntary NYSE American delisting and SEC deregistration, wind-down planned · terminated program · OA-201 in knee osteoarthritis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the Board has determined that it is in the Company’s best interests that the Company take steps designed to ensure sufficient cash to adequately fund an orderly wind down of the Company’s operations
evidence.program_discontinued: the pain reduction benefit was not observed in the data from a set of non-clinical studies of OA-201, resulting in the termination of the OA-201 program at that time.
